title: Attempt-only exact_identity_required check should take the project from the requested attempt's stamped snapshot
outcome: Attempt-only exact_identity_required check should take the project from the requested attempt's stamped snapshot
acceptance: stamped_archive_project (src/delegation_review_attempts.rs) prefers the stamped snapshot whose slot.submission_attempt equals the requested attempt, falling back only when that attempt has no stamped snapshot, so the diagnostic decides the project as read_exact_review_as_root does for the selected attempt

A deterministic test covers an unstamped legacy record whose attempts 1 and 2 are stamped with different projects: the attempt-2 project's root gets 400 exact_identity_required and the attempt-1 project's root gets the plain 404 for attempt 2
Exact-input focused tests and a clean review pair
